_about: Louis Ginzberg's The Legends of the Jews, the legends of the Bible's people gathered from Talmud, Midrash and later sources: volume 1 (preface dated March 24, 1909) and volume 2 (preface dated March 28, 1910), both translated from the German manuscript by Henrietta Szold. Volumes 3 and 4 are held: their translator is Paul Radin, whose Gutenberg catalogue dates (1883-1959) put the translation in copyright in the UK until the end of 2029, the same question as Milne. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02/03: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).
